label: Aruba CX 6100 48G 4SFP+ (JL676A)
description: Aruba CX 6100 48G 4SFP+ - 48x 1G RJ45 plus 4x 10G SFP+ uplinks. Layer 3 lite (static routing, RIP).
notes: HPE Aruba Networking CX 6100 Switch Series QuickSpecs, Technical Specifications, Description row for this model: "48x ports 10/100/1000BASE-T Ports 4x 1G/10G SFP ports". The template is therefore 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets and 4x SFP+ cages (1/1/49, 1/1/50, 1/1/51, 1/1/52), all of which HPE states as "1G/10G SFP", so every cage carries speedCaps 1000/10000 - before this they were asymmetric, with only the first uplink accepting a 1G optic. Not claimed here: PoE budget (the same row states 802.3af/802.3at and the power supply states the 370W or 139W Class 4 figure, but this spec declares no poe block). Source: https://www.hpe.com/us/en/collaterals/collateral.a00021859enw.html
